text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building responsive web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, and Stripe.

I’d be glad to help with your full-stack role. I’m comfortable working across front end and back end, designing APIs, and building reliable user-facing experiences with clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript foundations. I also value strong organization, clear communication, and delivering work from concept to final product.

One relevant project was a Restaurant ordering web app for Saffron Lane Kitchens, where I built an installable ordering app for 9 restaurants using React, Vite, Firebase, Stripe, and Workbox. It kept the menu and cart working on bad connections, and 22% of orders came through the app within 2 months.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss how I can contribute.
